tagline: Event/PEAD-anchored blend (25% ML-prediction / 25% fundamentals / 50% event) over the BROAD universe — the validated post-earnings-drift core, diluted to stay tradeable.

schedule.rationale: Live book. Rebalances the first of each month; run on the preceding weekend so positions are set for the first trading day.

rebalance_ledger.source: manual-seed (broker positions confirmed 2026-07-01; FIRST LIVE ENTRY for this sleeve - all prior aristeia entries are paper; MTZ was never held)

backtest.forward_note: Backtest on the broad universe, NOT a forward projection. Realistic forward ~25-29% after survivorship + 3-name concentration; per-2yr regime range -5% to 62% (median 20%). LIVE paper-track begins 2026-07-01.

caveats: SURVIVOR BIAS: survivors-only backtest universe, so CAGR is an UPPER BOUND. Of ~721 S&P names that left the index 2011-2026, only ~40 are genuine bankruptcies (the rest are M&A / ticker-changes, NOT losses) and are excluded from the panel. The failure-bias is bounded (momentum/quality screens avoid most pre-bankruptcy names) but real - not a survivorship-free track record.
Backtested 2011-2026 on the BROAD universe (no floor; trading = eligible), NOT a forward projection. Realistic forward ~25-29%; per-2yr regime CAGR -5% to 62% (median 20%).
E3/PEAD is the validated core: real post-earnings drift (survives zeroing announcement-window days), entered 3 days AFTER the filing — reacts to earnings, does not predict them.
Liquidity-survival 0.96 at a $5M-ADV lens — the edge is tradeable, not a microcap artifact (unlike the .7-event tilt it replaced).
TRUE daily mark-to-market: the -54% drawdown is the real intra-period low. Top-3 concentration = high single-name risk (178 distinct names rotated over the backtest).
Frictionless backtest: ignores ~757%/yr turnover cost, slippage, tax. LIVE forward paper-track (separate, vs SPY) begins 2026-07-01.
